seoTitle: Psywave — AI Apple Music Playlist Maker
metaDescription: Describe a mood or pick a photo and get a real Apple Music playlist of 25 songs in seconds. Save, remix, and export every mix. Start with 3 free playlists.
keywords: make a playlist from a photo
heroHeadline: Describe a mood. Get a real playlist.
heroSubhead: Type a vibe or pick a photo, and Psywave builds a 25-song Apple Music playlist of real tracks in seconds. One tap to import. No more endless scrolling.
highlights: 25 real songs per playlist, imported to Apple Music in one tap
Turn a photo into a soundtrack that fits the scene
Every playlist saved, ready to re-import or remix

features.title: Words In, Songs Out
features.body: Tell Psywave what you want to hear — "drum and bass intensity" or "focus for deep work" — and it builds a tracklist around that exact mood.

features.title: Photos Become Playlists
features.body: Point Psywave at a sunset, a road trip, or a rainy window. It reads the mood and colors, then scores the moment with real tracks.

features.title: See Your Sound
features.body: Every playlist comes with a genre breakdown chart, so you can see what your vibe is made of before you import it.

features.title: Remix And Extend
features.body: Remix any playlist into a fresh set, or add 10 more songs with one tap when you want the night to keep going.

features.title: Your Library Of Moods
features.body: Every playlist you generate is saved. Re-import any of them to Apple Music whenever the mood comes back around.

features.title: Export Anywhere
features.body: Share a playlist, copy the track list, or send a CSV that moves into Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL, or Deezer through Soundiiz or TuneMyMusic.

howItWorks.body: Type a mood, a scene, or a feeling in one line — or pick a photo from your library.
Psywave builds a 25-song playlist of real Apple Music tracks and shows you the genre breakdown.
Tap once to drop the playlist into your Apple Music library and press play.

faq.a: You start with 3 free playlists. After that, choose Psywave Pro for unlimited playlists, or buy a credit pack and pay only for what you make. Credits never expire.
Yes. The annual Psywave Pro plan includes a 7-day free trial. You can also try the app first with your 3 free playlists before paying anything.

faq.q: Do I need an Apple Music subscription?
faq.a: Yes. Psywave imports playlists directly into Apple Music, so an active Apple Music subscription is required to save and play them.

faq.q: What's the difference between Pro and credit packs?
faq.a: Pro is a subscription for unlimited playlists plus longer mixes of up to 50 songs. Credit packs are one-time and pay-as-you-go: each playlist costs one credit, and credits never expire.

faq.q: How does the photo feature work?
faq.a: Pick any photo and Psywave reads its mood, colors, and feeling, then builds a playlist of real songs that matches the scene.

faq.q: Can I move my playlists to Spotify or YouTube Music?
faq.a: Yes. Psywave exports a playlist as a CSV that imports into Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL, and Deezer through Soundiiz or TuneMyMusic, and you can also share or copy the track list directly.

faq.q: What devices does Psywave run on?
faq.a: Psywave runs on iPhone and iPad and requires iOS 17 or later.

faq.q: How do I cancel a subscription?
faq.a: Manage or cancel Psywave Pro anytime in your Apple ID subscription settings. The paywall is always dismissible, and your saved playlists stay available.
